create_edm_euler_scheduler: create an EDMEulerScheduler instance with Karras or exponential sigma schedule for diffusion model inference
set_timesteps_edm_euler: set the discrete timesteps and sigma schedule for the EDMEulerScheduler before running inference
step_edm_euler_denoising: perform one Euler denoising step using the scheduler to predict the previous sample from model output
precondition_outputs_edm: precondition model outputs using EDM formulation with c_skip and c_out scaling factors
add_noise_edm_euler: add sigma-scaled noise to original samples at specified timesteps for training or image-to-image tasks
